value: Owner: file the termination application with the zone
PRO: cancel every visa through the zone Investor Services Department, dependants first (or the AED 5,000 guarantee), settling employee entitlements first
Owner: collect the no-objection certificates the zone asks for
Owner: appoint a liquidator or auditor where the zone requires one
Accountant: apply for VAT deregistration within 20 business days and corporate tax deregistration within 3 months of cessation
Zone: deregister the company and issue the cancellation
steps.source: Boasis research, licence lifecycle, section 5 (Free zone pattern, Cancellation REPORTED, general and not SRTIP-specific) and section 4 (VAT and CT deregistration REPORTED); Boasis research, mainland employee lifecycle, section 12 (Residency cancellation CONFIRMED); https://uaefreezonefinder.com/how-to-close-or-liquidate-your-free-zone-company-in-the-uae-the-2026-exit-guide/ ; https://taxready.ae/vat-deregistration-uae/ ; https://www.saifaudit.com/blog/2026/06/12/company-liquidation-dubai/

value: Owner: check the package allows another visa (STARTER 0, GROWTH 1, ELITE 2)
Owner or PRO: file the application at the zone Investor Services Department, the only authorised channel; the PRO is named on the form and declarations are signed before a zone officer
Zone: obtains the entry permit, valid 60 days; the passport must have at least 8 months left
Person: enter the country or change status; residence must be completed within 55 days
Owner: buy the Northern Emirates basic health insurance (AED 320 a year, 2-year policy) before the residence is issued
Person, paid by the owner: medical fitness test at an EHS centre; the zone form requires the medical report
Zone: residence permit and Emirates ID through ICP (AED 100 application plus 100 a year plus 100 smart service; status adjustment AED 500)
steps.source: Boasis research, free zones per authority, Sharjah zones, SRTIP / SPark, items 1, 5, 6, 7 and 9 (CONFIRMED form; order of stages read from the form facts, not stated as a sequence) and Federal baseline (ICP residence fees CONFIRMED); Boasis research, mainland employee lifecycle, section 4 (EHS CONFIRMED) and section 7 (Northern Emirates CONFIRMED); https://icp.gov.ae/en/services-details/?serviceid=64afe3c1035448005bd52e64 ; https://www.ehs.gov.ae/EN/services/services-directory/examination-of-medical-fitness-for-residency-visa ; https://mohre.gov.ae/en/guidance-and-awareness-portal-new/the-basic-health-insurance-scheme

value: Owner: give the notice in the contract; federal law applies (Federal Decree-Law 33/2021), 30 to 90 days after probation, 14 days from the employer during probation
Accountant: compute the final settlement; gratuity within 14 days, permitted deductions within 3 months (Cabinet Resolution 1/2022 Art 29)
PRO: cancel the residence through the zone Investor Services Department to ICP, dependants first or the AED 5,000 guarantee; 2 days; AED 50 plus 100
Person: leave or change status within the grace period after cancellation (30, 60, 90 or 180 days by category)
